q: Who is Raoden's father?
explain: Iadon, a former merchant, became King of Arelon after the Reod.

q: Which kingdom is Princess Sarene from?
explain: Sarene, daughter of King Eventeo, comes to Arelon to marry Prince Raoden.

q: From which nation does the gyorn Hrathen come?
explain: Hrathen is sent from Fjorden to convert Arelon before it is too late.

q: Which religion does Hrathen preach in Arelon?
explain: Hrathen tries to turn the Arelenes away from Shu-Korath and towards Shu-Dereth.

q: Galladon, Raoden's first friend in Elantris, comes from which country?
explain: Galladon is a Dula who was taken by the Shaod and thrown into Elantris.

q: What is the name of Sarene's seon?
explain: Like every seon, Ashe is named after an Aon, which glows at its center.

q: What is the transformation that turns ordinary people into Elantrians called?
explain: Before the Reod, the Shaod made people godlike; afterwards it left them cursed.

q: What was the catastrophe that ruined Elantris ten years before the novel?
explain: In the Reod, Elantrians lost their powers and their city fell into filth and decay.

q: What alias does Raoden use inside Elantris to hide his identity?
explain: The name comes from Aon Rao, the Aon in Raoden's own name, which means spirit.

q: After the Reod, what happens to a cut an Elantrian receives?
explain: Elantrians' hearts no longer beat, and every wound keeps hurting forever.

q: What is the magic of drawing Aons in the air called?
explain: AonDor drew its power from the Dor and stopped working after the Reod.

q: Who is Sarene's uncle, living in Kae with his family?
explain: Kiin is the brother of King Eventeo of Teod and a superb cook.

q: What is the community Raoden builds inside the fallen city called?
explain: Raoden unites the city's gangs and gives the Elantrians work to fight their pain.

q: In which kingdom does the city of Elantris stand?
explain: Elantrians once ruled Arelon, until the Reod brought them down.

q: Who becomes King of Arelon at the end of Elantris?
explain: Restored as a true Elantrian, Raoden takes the throne with Sarene at his side.

q: How long does the Wyrn give Hrathen to convert Arelon before Fjorden destroys it?
explain: Hrathen knows Arelon will be invaded if he fails within that deadline.

q: From which city does King Iadon rule Arelon after the Reod?
explain: Kae is one of the four cities around Elantris; the others were abandoned after the Reod.

q: What effect does Aon Daa produce when drawn by an Elantrian?
explain: Aon Daa means power or energy and was the Elantrians' preferred weapon.

q: What are Elantrians called who are overwhelmed by pain and can only moan?
explain: Their wounds never heal, so pain accumulates until the Elantrian's mind gives way.

q: How does Hrathen stage a fake 'cure' for the Shaod?
explain: After being locked in Elantris, he takes an antidote and claims Jaddeth cured him.

q: What is the Derethi priest Dilaf secretly?
explain: Dilaf's bones were reshaped in the Dakhor monastery, granting him dark powers.

q: Which country is the baron Shuden from?
explain: Shuden is a skilled practitioner of the JinDo martial art ChayShan.

q: What event broke AonDor and caused the Reod?
explain: The resulting chasm changed the land of Arelon, which the Aons are tied to, so every Aon needed a new line.

q: Who is the god worshipped by the followers of Shu-Dereth?
explain: The Derethi believe Jaddeth will rise from beneath the earth once all people are united.

q: Why is Sarene considered Raoden's widow despite never meeting him?
explain: The treaty stated that if either betrothed died, the marriage would count as binding.

q: What is Raoden's seon, which loses its sanity after his Shaod, called?
explain: A seon whose master is taken by the broken Shaod goes mad.

q: What does Aon Ien do in AonDor?
explain: Healing with Aon Ien required modifiers specifying which part of the body to mend.

q: Which secret cult did King Iadon practise, sacrificing his own staff?
explain: After Sarene exposed him, Iadon was arrested and took his own life in prison.

q: Which nobleman was Sarene about to marry when she was cast into Elantris?
explain: On the wedding day she appeared to be taken by the Shaod (really another dose of Hrathen's potion), and Telrii took the throne.

q: From which older religion do both Shu-Dereth and Shu-Korath derive?
explain: Shu-Keseg originated in JinDo and taught the unity of all mankind.

q: Before coming to Arelon, Hrathen had instigated a revolution in which country?
explain: The bloodshed in Duladel haunted Hrathen and shaped his doubts about Wyrn's plans.

q: Which member of Kiin's family has been secretly hidden as an Elantrian?
explain: Kiin and Daora hid Adien's Shaod so he would not be thrown into Elantris.

q: What kind of Selish magic does Shai practise?
explain: Shai is considered one of the best Forgers in the Rose Empire.

q: Whose soul must Shai recreate in The Emperor's Soul?
explain: Assassins left Emperor Ashravan alive but with his mind destroyed.

q: Which elderly arbiter slowly comes to respect Shai's art?
explain: Unlike the other arbiters, Gaotona comes to see Forgery as a true art.

q: In which empire is The Emperor's Soul set?
explain: Ashravan is the forty-ninth emperor of the Rose Empire.

q: What does a Forger change with a soulstamp?
explain: A Forgery holds only if the rewritten past is plausible for the object.

q: What was Shai caught trying to steal?
explain: The Imperial Fool betrayed her, swapping her copy back for the real scepter.

q: How long a mourning period do the arbiters have to hide the emperor's state?
explain: If Ashravan did not reappear in time, the Heritage Faction would lose power.

q: To which faction do Ashravan and his arbiters belong?
explain: The faction depends on the emperor's survival to keep ruling the empire.

q: Which ambitious arbiter is the most powerful of the emperor's councillors?
explain: Frava secretly intends to control the restored emperor and to be rid of Shai.

q: Who is the captain of the guard who threatens to kill Shai one day?
explain: Zu is a Striker who personally escorts Shai to the arbiters.

q: What do Bloodsealers use as ink in their stamps?
explain: With it, a Bloodsealer can animate skeletons to hunt down a target.

q: What does an Essence Mark rewrite?
explain: Shai uses Essence Marks to briefly gain skills she does not normally have.

q: Which major award did The Emperor's Soul win in 2013?
explain: It won the Hugo for Best Novella.

q: Which rival faction is blamed for the attempt on Ashravan's life?
explain: An emperor's death would favour the Glory Faction's bid for the succession.

q: Which people of the Rose Empire does Shai belong to?
explain: Shai is a MaiPon, one of the peoples living within the Rose Empire.

q: Who is the protagonist of The Hope of Elantris?
explain: Matisse protects the children of New Elantris on the night of the Dakhor attack.

q: Which Shard Splintered Devotion and Dominion on Sel?
explain: Odium attacked the two Shards and left their power trapped around Sel.

q: What is the Dor, the power behind Selish magic?
a: The trapped power of two Shards
explain: Odium sealed the Investiture of the Splintered Devotion and Dominion in Sel's Cognitive Realm, where it forms the Dor.

q: How does Hrathen secretly communicate with the Wyrn from Arelon?
explain: Like every gyorn, Hrathen was secretly given a seon by the Wyrn, even though seons are Elantrian creations.

q: Who kills the Dakhor monk Dilaf in the climax of Elantris?
explain: Hrathen reveals his own Dakhor-trained strength to kill Dilaf before succumbing to his wounds.

q: Where inside Elantris does Aanden's gang make its home?
explain: Aanden set up his court in the university because Karata's gang held the palace.

q: Who dies protecting Raoden while he adds the Chasm Line to Elantris?
explain: Karata is beheaded fighting the Fjordell soldiers who try to stop Raoden, moments before Elantris is restored.

q: What did Raoden have to add to the Aons to make AonDor work again?
wrong: A dot at the center of each Aon
explain: The earthquake of the Reod opened a chasm that changed the land the Aons mirror, so every Aon needed a new line for it.

q: Once Shai's soulstamp works on Ashravan, how often must it be applied?
explain: The Forged soul does not take permanently, so Ashravan must be restamped each day.

q: Who betrayed Shai during the theft of the Moon Scepter?
explain: The Imperial Fool swapped the scepters and gave Shai up to the palace guards.

q: What is the name of the kindly Korathi priest in Kae who advises Sarene?
explain: Father Omin, the absent-minded Korathi priest of Kae, explains the Widow's Trial to Sarene and officiates her weddings.

q: From which country does Jalla, the wife of Lukel, come?
explain: Jalla is Svordish; she met Lukel while they were both studying at the Svordish university.

q: From which region of the Rose Empire does the art of Bloodsealing come?
explain: Bloodsealing is a Dzhamarian art, and the Strikers find it repugnant.

q: In the Derethi hierarchy, which rank sits directly below gyorn?
explain: A ragnat usually oversees a whole region of Derethi worshippers.

q: What is the lowest rank of Derethi priest?
explain: Dorven are the lowest Derethi priests and officially serve the gradors.

q: How many gyorns are there in the Fjordell Empire?
explain: There are only twenty gyorns, and in nations that follow Shu-Dereth even kings bow to them.

q: Which Derethi monastery is known for training assassins?
explain: Rathbore trains assassins, Fjeldor trains spies and Dakhor trains its bone-twisted warriors.

q: What physical trace did Hrathen keep from his time at the Dakhor monastery?
a: A nearly indestructible bone in his forearm
wrong: An Aon carved into his chest
A soulstamp mark on his neck
explain: Hrathen left Dakhor for another monastery, but one altered forearm bone remained, giving him great strength.

q: Which country does Forton, the potion-maker who supplies Hrathen, come from?
explain: Forton is a Hrovell apothecary whose potions, including the one that mimics the Shaod, Hrathen relies on.

q: Aanden calls himself a baron, but what was he before the Shaod?
explain: Aanden was really a sculptor named Taan, and he returns to sculpting after joining New Elantris.

q: In The Hope of Elantris, what is the name of the building where Matisse looks after the children?
explain: The Roost is the nursery of New Elantris, where Matisse helps care for the children.

q: Who is Matisse's adoptive father in The Hope of Elantris?
explain: Dashe, Karata's second in command, brought Matisse to Karata's palace after the Shaod took her.

q: Which Aon does Matisse draw to lure and blind the pursuing soldiers?
explain: Aon Ashe creates light, which Matisse uses first as a lure and then to dazzle the soldiers.

q: Which Aon did Elantrians use to travel instantly from place to place?
explain: Aon Tia is the Aon of travel, used for instant transportation before the Reod.

q: Which Aon serves as the symbol of the Korathi church and is carved on its chapels?
explain: Aon Omi is the emblem of Shu-Korath.

q: The chapel inside Elantris that becomes the heart of New Elantris originally belonged to which religion?
explain: The Elantrians built a Korathi chapel inside their city as a gesture of friendship toward Teod.

q: How many factions make up the government of the Rose Empire?
explain: Each of the eighty factions, such as Heritage and Glory, is led by five arbiters.

q: The Strikers descend from which people, absorbed long ago by the Rose Empire?
explain: The Grands renamed the Mulla'dil 'Strikers' after annexing their mountainous homeland.

q: In the forged past that Shai's Essence Mark Shaizan gives her, which warrior people trained her in martial arts?
explain: The Shaizan Mark rewrites Shai's past so that she spent years training with the Teullu, masters of the martial arts.

q: What does Frava offer Shai in an attempt to bribe her?
explain: On Day Seventeen, Frava tries to win Shai over with control of the city's smuggling operations.

q: How many Essence Marks had Shai created for herself?
explain: Shai's Essence Marks took years of work to create; each rewrites her past to give her different skills, such as Shaizan's fighting ability.

q: Forgers prefer soulstone for their stamps. How is it hardened after carving?
explain: Soulstone is soft and easy to carve in its natural state, then hardened by heating it.

q: How many moons orbit Sel?
explain: Sel has a single blue-white moon, Oem.
